reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in our DM to confirm the new 7 July cutoff for the Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork. She asked for no action, so I didn't take any.

- **Kept private:** I didn't save the date to GBrain or my persistent memory, because both can show up in other members' conversations. The note exists only in this DM.
- **Year:** July 2026 has already passed, so I said I'm reading it as 7 July 2027 and asked her to correct me if she meant something else.
- **Brain check:** GBrain has nothing on a Quarrendon paperwork cutoff, so no other note conflicts with hers. That search ran keyword-only, so it could miss notes worded differently.

My first attempt to send through the direct-message tool failed because it wanted a member, not a channel id. I posted to the DM channel instead, and that went through.
